findings.message: Asynchronous screenshot capture via queue_screenshot() with callbacks (avoids blocking)
Synchronous get_texture().get_image() identified as blocking (Godot Issue #75877)
5+ screenshot plugins evaluated (Screenshot, Godot Screen Capture, godot-screenshots, Screenshot Manager, GodotCameraCapture)
Performance singleton comprehensive monitoring (FPS, frame time, draw calls, vertices, memory)
RenderingServer and VisualServer metrics documented (draw calls, texture memory, render time)
Hardware tier detection system (CPU count, GPU vendor/name, memory usage)
3-tier classification system (low/medium/high) with GPU database
Performance targets defined (Tier 1: 90+ FPS, Tier 2: 60+ FPS, Tier 3: 30+ FPS)
Visual QA automation frameworks evaluated (GdUnit4, GUT, GoDotTest)
Godot Pixelmatch library for pixel-level image comparison (Asset Library #996)
Metadata schema defined (screenshot, hardware, performance, visual_qa, settings)
File organization structure standardized (evidence/visual/{tier}/{date}/)
CI/CD pipeline integration with GitHub Actions for screenshot validation
Multi-platform testing matrix (Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, iOS)
Capture points defined (launcher, spawn, 15s_exploration, first_guide_interaction, region_transition, combat)
Quality gates checklist (no debug letters, clipped actors, visible map edge, flat terrain, empty squares)
Reviewer requirements documented (identify player, guide, route, landmark, interaction, destination)
Release gates and recommendations framework
Integration with VS-013 (opening composition) and VS-014 (modern UI)
BACKROOMS MONSTERS support via VS-023
Child-safety constraints integrated
